Techtronics faces significant business risks in launching its new smartphone. From a market perspective, the primary risk is low consumer adoption due to market saturation and uncertainty surrounding the appeal of the unique feature. Competitors already dominate the space, making customer acquisition costly and difficult. Operationally, the rapid innovation cycle in the mobile industry poses a risk of premature obsolescence. The product may become outdated before Techtronics can recoup its development and marketing investments, leading to potential inventory write-downs and reduced return on investment.
